title: Army engineers: playing for officers and showing movies
summary: Drafted in 1942 into the engineers, he played piano at the officers' club, collecting money in his canteen, and sang and ran movies.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I went to the service in 1942.
In what branch?
Engineers.
Yeah? And what did you do there?
Huh?
What did you do in the engineering?
Play music.
You played the piano? Did they have a band?
I played for myself. I used to go play for the officers.
Oh, what? In the officers' club?
Played the officers' club.
You were proud?
I made more money playing in the home, and then I'm done doing all that.
Really? Are they paid you?

See, my canteen was my kidney cup. My canteen, where I used to drink out, was my kidney cup. Them guys started drinking that 7% beer down there. And I come home, my cup full of money, every night. Then I go to the PX and get that old 7% beer. But you had to be from the home to me to drink with you. I wouldn't afford the money to have.
What did you do? You just went in and played, like, just walked in and played and put your canteen up with the kids?
Put my canteen on the piano.
Oh, and then they'd come over and drop money?
Drop money in there.
What did they do, just sit around and listen to you?
Just sit around and listen to me.
Did you sing, too, while you were there? Yeah, I sang.
In fact, I was a movie projector. I made a movie. I showed the movies.
